fields.name: gene_1
fields.description: Ensembl gene ID for the first perturbed regulator in the pair, using official IGVF GENCODE version (V43). Conditionally required for promoter-targeting regulators.

fields.name: gene_1_symbol
fields.description: Gene symbol for the first perturbed regulator in the pair, from official IGVF GENCODE version (V43). Conditionally required for promoter-targeting regulators.

fields.name: genomic_element_1
fields.description: The perturbed element type e.g. promoter, enhancer, etc of the first perturbed regulator in the pair.

fields.name: genomic_element_coordinates_1
fields.description: The hg38 coordinates of the first perturbed regulator in the pair. If aggregated across multiple elements, comma-separate the coordinates.

fields.name: gene_2
fields.description: Ensembl gene ID for the second perturbed regulator in the pair, using official IGVF GENCODE version (V43). Conditionally required for promoter-targeting regulators.

fields.name: gene_2_symbol
fields.description: Gene symbol for the second perturbed regulator in the pair, from official IGVF GENCODE version (V43). Conditionally required for promoter-targeting regulators.

fields.name: genomic_element_2
fields.description: The perturbed element type e.g. promoter, enhancer, etc of the second perturbed regulator in the pair.

fields.name: genomic_element_coordinates_2
fields.description: The hg38 coordinates of the second perturbed regulator in the pair. If aggregated across multiple elements, comma-separate the coordinates.

fields.name: pearson_correlation
fields.description: Pearson correlation between the two regulators' log2FC values across gene programs.
